# Kristian Sägi

> Kristian Sägi is an engineering leader and the CEO of Entringo, a Hansab Group company in Tallinn, Estonia, that builds integrated vehicle flow systems (ticketless ANPR parking, yard and traffic management) from its own software and purpose-built hardware. He co-founded Playtech Mobile and scaled it to $120M in annual revenue, co-founded the mobile CI/CD platform Codemagic, and built Dynatrace's Tallinn engineering hub.

Key facts:

- Current role: Chief Executive Officer, Entringo (since April 2026). Entringo projects include fully ticketless parking at Tallinn Airport and centralized parking management at Vilnius International Airport.
- Dynatrace, Director of Engineering / Site Lead, Tallinn (2022–2025): built and led the Tallinn engineering lab after the acquisition of the local team, tripling headcount.
- Nevercode / Codemagic, Co-Founder & Head of Product Strategy (2017–2019), then Advisory Board member (2019–2022): created Codemagic, a CI/CD platform for Flutter and mobile apps, in partnership with Google's Flutter team.
- Playtech Mobile (Playtech plc), Co-Founder & CTO, Mobile Division (2005–2015): grew the division from inception to $120M in annual revenue and an organization of 100+ engineers and product managers.
- Early career (1996–2004): software engineer on the original team that built Persona, an HR and payroll system still in daily use, and later product manager for Persona at Fujitsu Estonia.
- Education: B.Sc. in Engineering Physics, University of Tartu. Co-author of a paper in the Journal of Applied Spectroscopy (2006).
- Mentoring: Ajujaht startup accelerator; ESA Business Incubation Centre Estonia.
- Languages: Estonian (native), English (full professional), Russian, German.
- Based in Tallinn, Estonia.
